rows.title_full:
AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF SUSTAINABLE CITIES AND
COMMUNITIES IN THE COUNTRY
rows.abstract:
Aims to promote inclusive, resilient, and sustainable urban development, ensure the inclusive use of urban space for housing and livelihood, improve access to basic services, develop integrated public transportation systems and green infrastructures, protect ecosystems, and manage risks to climate change and disasters.
Mandates all cities and municipalities with a majority of barangays classified by the PSA as urban areas
to align their plans, programs and activities towards the full implementation of this Act.

Tasks the Department of Human Settlements and Urban Development (DHSUD) in consultation with relevant government agencies, local government units, civil society organizations, the private sector and the academe to harmonize existing housing and urban development plans with this Act.

Directs national agencies and local government units to ensure their genuine and adequate participation in urban, regional, spatial, and environmental planning.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2023-02-15, transmitted to the Senate on 2023-02-20 and received by the Senate on 2023-02-20

AN ACT SUSPENDING THE IMPLEMENTATION OF THE USE OF MOTHER TONGUE AS
THE MEDIUM OF INSTRUCTION FOR KINDERGARTEN TO GRADE 3 PROVIDED
UNDER SECTION 4 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 10533, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE
“ENHANCED BASIC EDUCATION ACT OF 2013”
rows.title_short: Suspending The Implementation Of The Use Of Mother Tongue As The Medium Of Instruction For Kindergarten To Grade 3 Provided Under Section 4 Of Republic Act No. 10533, Otherwise Known As The “ Enhanced Basic Education Act Of 2013”
rows.abstract:
Seeks to address the lack of readiness and proper preparations that are necessary to implement the use of mother tongue as the medium of instruction for learners in Kindergarten to Grade 3.
Suspends the use of mother tongue until the certification by the DepEd on the readiness of all school districts to implement the mother tongue curriculum and that the prescribed books, teaching materials, and supplies to support it are available.
Tasks the DepEd to coordinate with the Komisyon sa Wikang Filipino (KWF) in developing books, teaching materials, and other supplies necessary in the implementation of the use of mother tongue within sixty (60) days from the effectivity of this Act.
Provides automatic repeal of this Act upon the approval of Congress of the assessment report and the certification of DepEd to Congress on the readiness of all school districts to implement the use of mother tongue or first language as the medium of instruction for learners in kindergarten to Grade 3.

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING PROTECTION AND INCENTIVES TO FREELANCE WORKERS
rows.abstract:
Seeks to recognize the right of freelance workers to protection from late or nonpayment of fees for services rendered.
Mandates hiring party obtaining or retaining the services of a freelance workers to execute a written contract with the freelance worker before the services are rendered which shall be written In plain language, understood by both parties and shall include the services to be provided by the freelance worker, details of compensation and other benefits, period of employment, grounds for breach of contract, and any other condition that the DOLE may direct.
Requires the payment of night shift differential and hazard pay to freelance workers.
Enumerates unlawful practices of hiring party committed against the freelance worker and provides the necessary penalty thereof.
Provides tax relief to freelancers provided under the National Internal Revenue Code of 1997, as amended and RA No. 9178 or the “Barangay Micro Business Enterprises (BMBEs) Act of 2002” and special assistance lane/desk in every BIR Revenue District Office.
